def test_Version_bump_prerelease__basic():
    # 1. Existing numeric prerelease -> increment numeric part
    v1 = Version(1, 2, 3, "rc.4")
    v1b = v1.bump_prerelease()
    assert v1b.prerelease == "rc.5"
    assert v1b.major == 1
    assert v1b.minor == 2
    assert v1b.patch == 3
    # original unchanged
    assert v1.prerelease == "rc.4"

    # 2. Existing non‑numeric prerelease -> add ".0"
    v2 = Version(2, 0, 0, "alpha")
    v2b = v2.bump_prerelease()
    assert v2b.prerelease == "alpha.0"
    assert v2b.patch == 0
    # original unchanged
    assert v2.prerelease == "alpha"

    # 3. No prerelease, token == "" -> prerelease becomes "1"
    v3 = Version(3, 4, 5)
    v3b = v3.bump_prerelease(token="")
    assert v3b.prerelease == "1"
    assert v3b.patch == 5
    # original unchanged
    assert v3.prerelease is None

    # 4. No prerelease, token is None -> default "rc.1"
    v4 = Version(3, 4, 5)
    v4b = v4.bump_prerelease(token=None)
    assert v4b.prerelease == "rc.1"
    assert v4b.patch == 5

    # 5. No prerelease, default token, bump_when_empty=True -> bump patch and add prerelease
    v5 = Version(1, 0, 0)
    v5b = v5.bump_prerelease(bump_when_empty=True)
    assert v5b.prerelease == "rc.1"
    assert v5b.patch == 1  # patch incremented because bump_when_empty=True

def test_Version___hash____hash_consistency_in_set():
    """Version instances must be usable as set elements and dict keys; equal versions map to the same slot."""
    v1 = Version(1, 2, 3, prerelease="beta", build="001")
    v2 = Version(1, 2, 3, prerelease="beta", build="002")  # same hash, different build
    # Set behaviour
    s = {v1, v2}
    assert len(s) == 1, "Both versions should occupy a single slot in a set"
    # Dict behaviour
    d = {v1: "first"}
    d[v2] = "second"
    assert len(d) == 1, "Both versions should map to the same key in a dict"
    assert d[v1] == "second", "Value should be overwritten by the second insertion"

def test_Version_bump_minor__basic():
    # Start with a typical version
    original = Version(major=3, minor=4, patch=5)
    # Perform the bump
    bumped = original.bump_minor()
    # Expected result: major unchanged, minor incremented, patch reset to 0
    assert bumped.major == 3
    assert bumped.minor == 5
    assert bumped.patch == 0
    assert bumped.prerelease is None
    assert bumped.build is None
    # Ensure the original instance is left untouched
    assert original.major == 3
    assert original.minor == 4
    assert original.patch == 5
    assert original.prerelease is None
    assert original.build is None


def test_Version_bump_patch__basic():
    # Start with a version that has no prerelease or build metadata
    original = Version(major=3, minor=4, patch=5)
    # Execute the method under test
    bumped = original.bump_patch()
    # Expected result: patch incremented, prerelease/build reset to None
    assert bumped.major == 3
    assert bumped.minor == 4
    assert bumped.patch == 6
    assert bumped.prerelease is None
    assert bumped.build is None
    # Ensure the original instance is left untouched
    assert original.major == 3
    assert original.minor == 4
    assert original.patch == 5
    assert original.prerelease is None
    assert original.build is None
